name: CTRLRun
description: Checks every tool call against a CTRLRun policy before it runs, and records what happened after.

url.description: Where the CTRLRun bridge is listening. Loopback.

token.description: The bridge's shared secret. Falls back to $CTRLRUN_OPENCLAW_TOKEN.

timeoutMs.description: Kept under before_tool_call's 15s fail-closed budget so a refusal explains itself.

approvalMode.description: native raises OpenClaw's approval prompt; block-and-retry refuses and names the request for 'ctrlrun approve'.

tools.description: Canonical OpenClaw tool ids to gate, such as exec or apply_patch. Omit to gate every tool.
